text.p: Here are the main headlines from Lithuania's M-1 plus radio station's noon news report on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Klaipeda council administrator Valdemaras Anuzhis said that the documents of the municipal inspection for the last two years have disappeared. He also said that the inspection audits on companies run by the council cannot be found.

- Veterans of the Afghanistan war urged the government to issue new documents confirming their veteran status. Documents issued by the former Soviet Union ceased to be valid at the start of the year and veterans were stripped of medical benefits.
